run.change_description: fix(utils/body,validator): normalize Content-Type media type for case-insensitive matching

summary.intent: Fix honojs/hono#5060: parseBody() and validator('json'|'form') matched Content-Type media types case-sensitively, so mixed/upper-case values like `Application/JSON` were silently skipped. The change lowercases only the media-type segment (before the first `;`) for comparison/normalization and adds an `i` flag to the validator's regexes, leaving parameters such as multipart boundaries untouched.
summary.issue_fit: Met — all three scenarios #5060 asked for (parseBody with mixed-case urlencoded, validator('json') with mixed-case JSON, validator('form') with mixed-case urlencoded/multipart while preserving the boundary) are implemented and covered by new passing tests.
